scripts.dev: python3 scripts/migrate_local_d1.py && bun run build:client && vite
scripts.db:local:sync: uv run --with openpyxl --with rapidfuzz python3 scripts/sync_local_d1.py
scripts.test:python: uv run --with rapidfuzz --with openpyxl python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:python
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name product-price-matrix --commit-dirty=true
